name: Paklarn
description: Paklarn was a planet in the Paklarn system in the Abaar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, the smuggler Nevil Cygni set up an iridium smuggling operation on Paklarn that involved the mineral being hidden in grist mollusk shells. In 11 BBY, Imperial Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo uncovered Cygni's operation due to predatory makorr that the smugglers were attracting with discarded mollusk meat. Cygni's men were then arrested.
